title: Depth bound for bounded unfolding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct input vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one input. For every natural number $f$, vertex index $v$, and polarity $p$, if $v<n+	ext{number of gates of }C$ and $v<f$, then the depth of the tree obtained by unfolding $v$ with fuel $f$ and polarity $p$ is at most the depth assigned to vertex $v$ by $C$.
